content:
## Task
Improve the post-route quality of `priority32` (32-bit registered priority encoder: index of the highest set bit of a, plus a found flag) without changing its behavior.

## Specification (current RTL, also the equivalence reference)
```verilog
module priority32 (
    input wire clk,
    input wire rst_n,
    input wire valid_i,
    input wire [31:0] a_i,
    input wire [31:0] b_i,
    output reg valid_o,
    output reg [5:0] y_o
);

wire hit_0 = |a_i[31:0];
wire [4:0] idx_0 = a_i[31] ? 5'd31 : a_i[30] ? 5'd30 : a_i[29] ? 5'd29 : a_i[28] ? 5'd28 : a_i[27] ? 5'd27 : a_i[26] ? 5'd26 : a_i[25] ? 5'd25 : a_i[24] ? 5'd24 : a_i[23] ? 5'd23 : a_i[22] ? 5'd22 : a_i[21] ? 5'd21 : a_i[20] ? 5'd20 : a_i[19] ? 5'd19 : a_i[18] ? 5'd18 : a_i[17] ? 5'd17 : a_i[16] ? 5'd16 : a_i[15] ? 5'd15 : a_i[14] ? 5'd14 : a_i[13] ? 5'd13 : a_i[12] ? 5'd12 : a_i[11] ? 5'd11 : a_i[10] ? 5'd10 : a_i[9] ? 5'd9 : a_i[8] ? 5'd8 : a_i[7] ? 5'd7 : a_i[6] ? 5'd6 : a_i[5] ? 5'd5 : a_i[4] ? 5'd4 : a_i[3] ? 5'd3 : a_i[2] ? 5'd2 : a_i[1] ? 5'd1 : a_i[0] ? 5'd0 : 5'd0;

wire [5:0] chosen_0 = hit_0 ? {1'b1, idx_0} : 6'd0;

always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (!rst_n) begin
        valid_o <= 1'b0;
        y_o <= 6'd0;
    end else begin
        valid_o <= valid_i;
        if (valid_i)
            y_o <= chosen_0;
    end
end
endmodule
```
Your design must be cycle-for-cycle equivalent to this module from reset: same ports, synchronous active-low reset, `valid_o` follows `valid_i` one cycle later, and `y_o` updates only on valid cycles and holds otherwise.

## Flow and objective
Yosys/ABC synthesis to the Nangate45 library, then OpenROAD placement, clock tree synthesis and routing with a 10 ns clock and a fixed floorplan. Score = 10 * WNS_ns - 0.001 * area_um2, where WNS is the worst setup slack after routing and area is total standard-cell area. Higher is better.

This RTL measured: area 208.81 um^2, WNS 7.64557 ns, score 76.24689.
estimate_ppa on this RTL returns area 138.586 um^2, WNS 7.70216 ns, estimated score 76.883014 (estimates omit tap cells, buffering and wiring, so compare estimates with estimates).

## Rules
- One module of synthesizable Verilog-2005 (no helper modules or instances; the equivalence checker compares flat modules). The module name and ports must not change.
- No initial blocks, system tasks, compiler directives or technology cells.
- place_and_route budget: 4 submissions. Every submission counts, including failed ones.
- At most 30 tool calls in total.

Tools available: simulate, prove_equivalence, estimate_ppa, place_and_route, finish. Your score is the best verified place_and_route score. Call finish when you are done.

content.text: Good, both pass. Let me check estimate_ppa to see if this simplification changes anything, and also try alternative structuring for further gains.
The simplification improved area and WNS estimates. Let's verify with full place_and_route.

We've confirmed that the RTL simplification (removing the redundant final mux term that always evaluates to the same value) is functionally equivalent and yields a real improvement, verified by simulation, formal equivalence, and place-and-route. Multiple alternative codings (balanced tree, casez one-hot, explicit shared OR-tree) all converge to the same synthesis result via ABC's logic optimization, confirming we've reached the practical ceiling for this simple combinational function. I'll finalize with the validated best design.

input.summary: Simplified priority32 by removing a redundant final mux term in the idx_0 priority-encoder chain (the original `a_i[0] ? 5'd0 : 5'd0` always evaluates to 5'd0 regardless of a_i[0], and separately replaced the outer `hit_0 ? {1,idx_0} : 6'd0` mux with a direct concatenation `{hit_0, idx_0}`, which is equivalent since idx_0 is already 0 whenever hit_0 is 0). This is proven cycle-exact equivalent via Yosys equiv_induct and passes the full simulation benchmark. I explored several alternative codings (balanced binary leading-one-detector tree, one-hot casez priority decoder, explicit shared OR-reduction tree for the hit flag) via estimate_ppa; all converged to the same or worse post-synthesis area/timing than the simplified cascaded-mux version, confirming that ABC's logic optimization already finds the same minimal netlist regardless of RTL structural style for this function, so no further RTL-level restructuring was fruitful. The simplified design was verified end-to-end with place_and_route: area 201.096 um^2, WNS 7.66747 ns, score 76.473604 (baseline was 208.81 um^2, WNS 7.64557 ns, score 76.24689), an improvement of about +0.227 in score through area and slack gains. This is the best verified result and is submitted as final.
